draw_schedule.episode_order: Sort exactly 1000 heuristic and 1000 teacher rows by episode index; require identical paired u32 seeds.
draw_schedule.generator_scope: Create a new numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(seed)) for each difficulty, using the same registered seed.
draw_schedule.implementation_check: Record NumPy version and SHA256 of concatenated little-endian int64 resample indices per difficulty; any batching must match the specified reference stream.
draw_schedule.metric_index_reuse: Use that same index vector for teacher and heuristic and for both score and alive-frame ratios in that resample.
draw_schedule.per_resample: For each j in range(10000), draw generator.integers(0,1000,size=1000,dtype=numpy.int64,endpoint=False).
draw_schedule.stream_order: Process resamples in increasing j. No additional generator draws. Retained resample arrays have axes [resample, episode] in C order.

qualification_budget.includes: All 2000 teacher episodes, paired-bootstrap calculations, and summary generation.
qualification_budget.incomplete: Any partial, failed, capped-by-wall, or interrupted B campaign consumes the one overnight opening and is incomplete, never a pass or automatic retry.
qualification_budget.preflight: Before any B episode, register one frozen candidate, actual wrapper/model identities, measured development inference/environment throughput and bootstrap timing, and a conservative projection for all 2000 episodes at the 18000-frame cap. Open B only if projected full work fits 1800 seconds and current UTC plus 1800 plus 600 is at or before cutoff.
qualification_budget.resources: Observed peak process RSS <=6442450944 bytes; if MPS is used, its driver allocation has a separate guard of the same size. Cooperative checks and retained samples.

evaluation.reserved_replication: unopened until qualification passes and full replication budget plus600s fits cutoff; then teacher and frozen heuristic once per difficulty

overnight_rule: no weakening, mode selection, best-of checkpoint selection, or cap changes after teacher results; changed policies require future explicit review rather than rewriting this file
